items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1962-01-04
items.q: And your name? Book Free World.

ctx.x: Okay, let me see, I'll check the microphone just to get a little something on here. Today is January the 4th, is that right? Correct. January 4th, 1962, and we're recording at 1515 North Roman Street. Can we get your name on here? Full name? Ah, Boy Bang Senior. And your name? Book Free World. And I'm Dick Allen. Good, I think I got it going. I think we got most of your life down before, but I just want to follow up on some of the things. How is your brother tied in with these picnics? I don't really quite…
We had so many. I just can't say the name of them. No. How would they look?
